versions.content: The function RamTst_Suspend shall temporarily prohibit the RamTst_MainFunction from performing tests at its next schedul ed call. When RamTst_Suspend is called and the execution status is RAMTST_ EXECUTION _RUNNING , testing stops after the current atomic sequence, test result and current test states are retained and t he execution status is changed to RAMTST_ EXECUTION _SUSPEN DED.
